title: Thumbprint on the haddock.
html_source:
Haddock have a distinctive dark blotch above the pectoral fin, often described as a “thumbprint” or even the “Devil’s thumbprint” or “St. Peter’s mark”.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haddock
